recs.stt: Google Cloud Firestore NoSQL database is in GA
recs.x:
While the move seems to be towards NewSQL databases (Spanner/CockroachDB), the answer to relations in NoSQL is to model the data differently. This can generally resolve a lot of the problems inherent in the need for relations.

This might not be useful advice for everyone, but I can highly recommend this [link] video on DynamoDB data modelling: [link]

recs.stt: Designing database: split into different tables or group them together?
recs.x:
If you go single table you can use filtered indexes if your database supports it to speed up queries instead of having to do a row by row search with a where clause.

Personally this seems like a job for DynamoDB but that’s a whole beast unto itself. You must know the queries you will do to the database before hand as that guides how you craft it. There’s an amazing talk at reinvent that is given almost every year on creating a DynamoDB schema ( [link] )
